relations.subject: Samuel Louis Graham Sandberg
relations.evidence: From 1885 Chaplain in Indian Service working in various parts of (what was then) Bengal. In Darjeeling began the study of Tibetan. Retired because of an illness in 1904.

relations.subject: Samuel Louis Graham Sandberg
relations.evidence: Son of Rev. Paul Louis Sandberg (1819–1878), a vicar and former (1843-49) missionary in India
